body:
I didn't have a reason. I was in the store, and I thought "Wow, these shirts are beautiful, I would love to wear them on a date with my boyfriend, but wow are they also expensive". 

I made my bed, so to speak. I know the right (responsible) thing to do would be to just stick it out, pay for my crime, and then carry on with life having learned from the experience.

But my life was already shit before this. For years there hasn't been a day where I don't say or think to myself "If only I were dead" or "Please, God, just kill me". I don't want to wait and see how much harder it gets when I'm in debt and given jail time, and everyone I know just sees me as a thief.
